Specialty patient-assistance and foundation help: 844-645-7262. No public instructions for a standing autopay on the pharmacy account or for paperless statements.

entries.service_area_detail: ~600 U.S. warehouse pharmacies plus Costco Mail Order Pharmacy (membership not required for pharmacy). Retail copays are paid at pickup; mail order is charged to the card on file.
entries.phone_customer_service: 1-800-607-6861 (Costco Pharmacy / mail order; agent Mon-Fri 5am-7pm PT, Sat 9:30am-2pm PT); fax 1-800-633-0334
entries.senior_programs: Costco Member Prescription Program discount card for uninsured members; drug directory shows cash prices.
entries.notes: The FAQ says mail order accepts Visa, Mastercard, Discover and the Costco credit card; payment card and insurance are updated in the Patient Profile (https://www.costco.com/pharmacy/patient-profile). Order history is under the account's Buy Again / orders area. rx.costco.com offers Pay Ahead for store pickup (pay online, show a QR code at the counter); https://rx.costco.com/pay-ahead is a JS app. Email webpharmacy@costco.com. FAQ: home delivery pharmacy takes Visa, MasterCard, Discover and Costco credit card. Card changes are made by updating the Patient Profile. Processing takes 1-4 days, then delivery 6-14 days. Costco Pharmacy FAQ  says Home Delivery accepts Visa, Mastercard, Discover and Costco credit cards and directs account changes to the online Patient Profile; it gives no autopay-cancel, receipt-history, paperless or assistance instructions. Pharmacy help 1-800-607-6861 (M-F 5am-7pm PT, Sat 9:30am-2pm PT), webpharmacy@costco.com.

entries.name: CVS Caremark
entries.service_area_detail: PBM and mail-service pharmacy (CVS Caremark Mail Service Pharmacy) and CVS Specialty; also runs SilverScript/Aetna Medicare Part D pharmacy benefits. Nationwide.
entries.phone_customer_service: 1-800-552-8159 (TTY 711; Mon-Fri 7am-9pm CT, Sat 8am-noon CT). The member-ID-card number also works; chat is available 24/7 with a virtual assistant, and live chat Mon-Fri 8am-8pm ET
entries.notes: The Help Center  has 'Payments and billing', 'Order status and history' and 'Cost and coverage' topics. Contact page: https://www.caremark.com/about-us/contact-us.html. Order status: https://www.caremark.com/pharmacy/-/orders. Robots.txt disallows most of the site. General Customer Service number: 1-800-552-8159. Correspondence (not payments): CVS Caremark Customer Care Correspondence, PO Box 6590, Lee's Summit, MO 64064-6590. The answers expand only inside the app, so their text was not captured.

entries.name: CVS Pharmacy (retail)
entries.service_area_detail: ~9,000 retail pharmacies (reduced by closures) plus in-Target CVS pharmacies; also absorbed many Rite Aid prescription files in 2025. Retail pharmacy: copays are normally paid at pickup, so there is usually no monthly bill.
entries.phone_customer_service: 1-800-SHOP-CVS (1-800-746-7287) pharmacy customer service, Mon-Fri 8:30am-7pm ET, Sat-Sun 10am-6:30pm ET; CVS.com and app help 1-888-607-4287
entries.senior_programs: CVS Health Savings Pass (discount generic program for uninsured; ask a pharmacist). FSA cards accepted for copays. Fee-for-service Medicaid accepted.
entries.notes: The Prices, Insurance and Payments help page says in-store pickup orders are paid at the pharmacy when picked up; the out-of-pocket cost is known only after the insurance claim is processed and posts to the online account after a few hours. CVS does not post cash prices online. Contact page: https://www.cvs.com/help/help_contact_us.jsp. No public autopay or statement doc for retail. Prices, Insurance and Payments help: in-store pickup orders are paid at the pharmacy counter. FSA cards are accepted for copays. Cash prices are not posted online. FSA cards are accepted for copays; if insurance does not cover a drug, CVS may bill you directly so you can seek reimbursement; order totals post to the online prescription-management account after processing. CVS accepts fee-for-service Medicaid but not out-of-state Medicaid.

entries.name: CVS Specialty
entries.service_area_detail: Specialty pharmacy; nationwide.
entries.senior_programs: Care team connects patients to manufacturer copay cards and patient assistance foundations.
entries.notes: FAQ: online payments accept Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover or e-check; phone and mail also take checks, HSA/FSA cards and money orders (mail only). Autopay can be scheduled for a fixed day each month, for a set amount or the balance up to a pre-authorized limit. The payments video page walks through Balance and Payments, Set Up Automatic Payment, and payment history (same page used for view, autopay, and history).

entries.name: Express Scripts Pharmacy
entries.service_area_detail: PBM and mail-order pharmacy; Accredo is its specialty pharmacy. Nationwide.
entries.phone_pay_by_phone: (800) 282-2881 (or the number on your prescription ID card)
entries.senior_programs: Extended Payment Plan (3 interest-free monthly installments). The Medicare Prescription Payment Plan is run by the Part D plan.
entries.notes: The FAQ explains: payment methods; Autopay, which charges automatically each time a prescription ships and lets you set a maximum amount above which you are asked to confirm; no charge until the order ships; and Claims History (Prescriptions > Claims History) for out-of-pocket spend by date range. The Extended Payment Plan splits eligible prescription costs into 3 equal monthly card payments with no fee. The logged-in Pay a Bill deeplink is https://www.express-scripts.com/deeplink/makepayment. No public page on cancelling Autopay; change it in the account or call member services. The FAQ  is the one page for all tasks. Pay with card, checking account or PayPal. The Extended Payment Plan splits eligible orders into 3 interest-free monthly card payments. AutoPay charges only when an order ships, and you can set a maximum amount it may charge. Stop or change AutoPay under Account preferences, or call (800) 282-2881. Order status and Claims History are in the online account. Express Scripts FAQ: Autopay charges your saved card or account each time a prescription ships, with an optional maximum charge limit; manage it under payment settings after signing in. Claims History (Prescriptions menu) shows out-of-pocket costs for the last 6-24 months and can be downloaded/printed for taxes or FSA. Extended Payment Plan splits eligible prescription costs into three monthly card payments with no fee; Medicare Prescription Payment Plan info at esrx.com/mppp. Customer service (800) 282-2881.

entries.name: Genoa Healthcare (behavioral health pharmacies)
entries.service_area_detail: ~600 pharmacies inside community mental health centers. Retail pharmacy: copays are normally paid at pickup, so there is usually no monthly bill. Any unpaid pharmacy balance or delivery order is paid in the store, the app, or the pharmacy account. Detailed support pages not researched.
entries.notes: Genoa (Optum) runs pharmacies inside community mental health centers and assisted living. No phone on the contact page (web form only); call your Genoa pharmacy. Genoa's E-Bill Express (Fiserv) page lets you pay now with account number and ZIP, or enroll to view and pay bills and see account status and payment history.

entries.name: Good Neighbor Pharmacy (independent pharmacy network)

Any unpaid pharmacy balance or delivery order is paid in the store, the app, or the pharmacy account. Detailed support pages not researched.

entries.name: Guardian Pharmacy Services (long-term care)
entries.service_area_detail: LTC pharmacy for assisted living and nursing homes; residents/families are billed monthly. The domain refused automated connection. Long-term-care pharmacy: residents or families usually get a monthly statement for copays and non-covered medications. Detailed support pages not researched.
entries.notes: Https://www.guardianpharmacy.com refuses connections, but guardianpharmacy.net redirects to https://guardianpharmacy.com/ and that loads. The site has no central bill-pay or family billing page. Billing is done by each local Guardian pharmacy (about 50 locally branded pharmacies, e.g. Middle Tennessee Pharmacy Services); use the locations page https://guardianpharmacy.com/locations/ and the number on the monthly statement.

entries.name: Health Mart (independent pharmacy franchise)
entries.service_area_detail: ~4,000+ independently owned pharmacies; each store bills its own customers (house charge accounts are common for seniors). Retail pharmacy: copays are normally paid at pickup, so there is usually no monthly bill. Any unpaid pharmacy balance or delivery order is paid in the store, the app, or the pharmacy account. Detailed support pages not researched.

entries.name: Honeybee Health
entries.service_area_detail: Online cash-price mail-order pharmacy. Mail-order pharmacy: prescriptions are charged to the card on file when an order ships, or a balance is billed to your online account. Detailed support pages not researched.

entries.name: Independent community pharmacies (NPPES roster, all states)
entries.service_area_detail: About 38,000 non-chain community/retail pharmacy NPIs (all 50 states, DC, PR, GU, VI, MP) are listed with address, city, state, ZIP and phone in rosters/pharmacies_independent_nppes.csv, built this session from the NPPES NPI Registry API (taxonomy Community/Retail Pharmacy, organization NPIs, queried by ZIP prefix). National and grocery chains, hospital/clinic/VA/IHS, specialty, mail-order, infusion and LTC pharmacies were filtered out. NPPES keeps NPIs of many closed stores active (e.g. Osco, Kerr Drug, Pathmark, A&P, Farmer Jack), so confirm the pharmacy is open before relying on a row.
entries.notes: Small-town independents are the pharmacies most likely to offer a monthly house charge account (a real monthly bill for seniors); ask the store how to pay it (in person, by phone, or by mail). Many independents belong to Health Mart, Good Neighbor Pharmacy (AmerisourceBergen/Cencora), Medicine Shoppe or Medicap networks.

entries.name: Kroger Pharmacy (and banners: Ralphs, Fred Meyer, King Soopers, Smith's, Fry's, QFC, Dillons, Harris Teeter, Mariano's, Pick 'n Save, Baker's, City Market, Gerbes, Jay C, Pay Less, Metro Market)
entries.service_area_detail: ~2,200 pharmacies across 35 states under Kroger banners; Kroger Specialty Pharmacy. Kroger domains refused automated connections. Retail pharmacy: copays are normally paid at pickup, so there is usually no monthly bill. Any unpaid pharmacy balance or delivery order is paid in the store, the app, or the pharmacy account. Detailed support pages not researched.
entries.phone_customer_service: 1-800-KRO-GERS (the FAQ pages print it as 888-852-2567; earlier record 800-576-4377 is the letter-number equivalent of 1-800-KRO-GERS); My Prescriptions account help 855-489-2502; or the store pharmacy
entries.payment_processor: in-house (My Prescriptions Pay Online; requires a Shopper's Card)
entries.notes: My Prescriptions (web and app) lets you set up Auto Refill, pay online (Shopper's Card required), review expense reports and view prescription history. Kroger Specialty Pharmacy FAQ: https://www.krogerspecialtypharmacy.com/patient/faq.php. Online-payment FAQ: in My Prescriptions go to Prescription Status > Pay Online, pick the prescriptions and a card from My Wallet. The card is pre-authorized for $0 and charged at pickup. A Shopper's Card must be linked, and new or transferred prescriptions cannot be paid online the first time. The Account Setup FAQ says My Prescriptions shows prescription history and expense reports. Caregivers use 'Access Another Adult'; the other adult must create their own account and grant access.

entries.name: Mark Cuban Cost Plus Drug Company
entries.service_area_detail: Mail-order cash-price pharmacy (the site is behind Cloudflare, 403). Mail-order pharmacy: prescriptions are charged to the card on file when an order ships, or a balance is billed to your online account. Detailed support pages not researched.

entries.name: Mark Cuban Cost Plus Drug Company (online pharmacy)
entries.parent_company: Mark Cuban Cost Plus Drug Company, PBC
entries.service_area_detail: National mail-order generics at cost +15% + pharmacy fee + shipping; also partner retail pharmacies
entries.payment_processor: in-house (card on file; auto-refill charges the card on file)
entries.notes: No membership fee (pay per order: cost +15% + pharmacy fee + shipping). The FAQ has an 'Automatic Refills' section (sign up, skip or cancel an auto-refill, which card is charged) and 'Where can I find my receipt?' / 'How do I view my order history?' questions; account Order Status and Payments pages require sign-in. Support is by web contact form (no phone published). FAQ includes an insurance section; check whether your Part D plan is accepted before paying cash. MEDICARE: A discount card or Rx membership price cannot be combined with Medicare Part D on the same prescription. Paying cash with a discount usually does not count toward the Part D deductible or the 2026 out-of-pocket cap ($2,100) unless the pharmacy submits it to the plan, so compare the cash price with the Part D copay. The membership fee itself is not covered by Medicare.

entries.name: Medicap Pharmacy (franchise independents)

entries.service_area_detail: Franchised independent pharmacies (IA and Midwest heaviest); NPPES lists ~160 Medicap-named pharmacy NPIs, some closed. Retail pharmacy: copays are normally paid at pickup; some regional and independent pharmacies offer monthly charge (house) accounts billed by the store.

entries.name: MedImpact / Birdi pharmacy

Mail-order copays are charged to the card on file or billed to your mail-order account. Detailed support pages not researched.
entries.notes: Former Elixir (Rite Aid's PBM / Elixir mail order) members keep their card and now deal with MedImpact; Rite Aid itself closed its stores in 2025 (prescription files largely moved to CVS and others).

entries.name: Navitus Health Solutions
entries.service_area_detail: Pass-through PBM. Pharmacy benefit manager: it does not bill you for retail prescriptions (you pay the pharmacy). Mail-order copays are charged to the card on file or billed to your mail-order account. Detailed support pages not researched.

entries.name: Onco360 Oncology Pharmacy
entries.service_area_detail: Specialty oncology pharmacy. Specialty pharmacy: the copay is quoted and charged during the refill scheduling call, and any unpaid balance is billed by statement or through the online account. Detailed support pages not researched.
entries.mail_payment_address: Onco360, Attn: Billing Department, 13410 Eastpoint Centre Drive, Suite 101, Louisville, KY 40223
entries.senior_programs: OncoAdvocate team finds third-party copay foundation funding; 67% of patients had $0 out-of-pocket in 2025.
entries.notes: Bill Pay Options page: pay online (account number + Statement ID), by check with the monthly statement, or in the myOnco360 app/portal; e-statement enrollment and view/print statements with account number and statement ID. Accepts cards, HSA/FSA, paper or electronic checks. BrightSpring subsidiary.

entries.name: Optum Rx / Optum Home Delivery
entries.service_area_detail: PBM and mail-order (Optum Home Delivery) pharmacy; serves UnitedHealthcare/AARP Medicare Part D members; Optum Specialty Pharmacy.
entries.phone_customer_service: 1-800-356-3477 (24/7, incl. Optum Home Delivery); Medicare PDP 1-877-889-5802; Medicare MAPD 1-877-889-6358; Specialty 1-855-427-4682; tech support 1-800-788-4863
entries.notes: The Manage Account page covers payment methods (bank account, credit/debit, FSA/HSA). A 'preferred' payment method is charged automatically for orders such as automatic refills (the closest thing to autopay). The same page covers caregiver access and managing plan members, which is useful for adult children paying for a senior. Contact page: https://www.optumrx.com/en/contact-us.html. The contact page  lists them as the Medicare fraud line (1-800-MEDICARE) and the prescriber prior-authorization line, which are not member billing lines.

entries.name: PharMerica
entries.service_area_detail: Long-term care / institutional pharmacy serving nursing homes, assisted living and hospice; residents or families may get bills.
entries.notes: Omnicare (the CVS LTC pharmacy) went through bankruptcy and wind-down in 2025; former Omnicare residents may now be billed by another LTC pharmacy.

entries.name: Prime Therapeutics (Blue Cross PBM)
entries.service_area_detail: PBM for many Blue Cross plans; mail order usually through a partner pharmacy. Pharmacy benefit manager: it does not bill you for retail prescriptions (you pay the pharmacy). Mail-order copays are charged to the card on file or billed to your mail-order account. Detailed support pages not researched.

entries.name: Rite Aid (legacy)
entries.service_area_detail: Rite Aid closed all stores and pharmacies in 2025; prescription files went mostly to CVS, Walgreens, Albertsons and Kroger banners and others. The riteaid.com brand now sells lab tests, says 'Pharmacy services (coming soon!)', and has Rx Transfer and Rx Records pages (https://riteaid.com/pharmacy-records; text 863-270-9911). Legacy Bartell Drugs (WA) closed too. The Rite Aid credit card and Rite Aid pharmacy house accounts no longer bill. Retail pharmacy: copays are normally paid at pickup, so there is usually no monthly bill. Any unpaid pharmacy balance or delivery order is paid in the store, the app, or the pharmacy account. Detailed support pages not researched.
entries.notes: Pharmacy Records page: Rite Aid retail locations closed; the Medchart records-request system stopped taking requests Dec 31, 2025. Active prescriptions moved to a nearby pharmacy (usually Walgreens, CVS or a local independent; the receiving pharmacy name is on late-2024 bottles), which can print prescription history. Insurers keep full claims history. Rite Aid no longer issues pharmacy bills; for old balances or receipts, contact the receiving pharmacy or your insurer.

entries.name: Senderra Specialty Pharmacy
entries.service_area_detail: National mail-order specialty pharmacy (oncology, hepatitis C, inflammatory and other specialty drugs) shipping to patients' homes.
entries.senior_programs: Copay and financial assistance team enrolls patients in manufacturer and foundation assistance programs.
entries.notes: Patients page  says Senderra keeps your payment information on file for refills (card-on-file auto-charge per refill shipment); no public page on removing it, so call 888-777-5547 to change or remove the card. Financial Assistance page  invites patients to contact the financial assistance team. Contact page: patients/refills 888-777-5547 (24/7 pharmacist), fax 888-777-5645.

entries.name: The Medicine Shoppe Pharmacy
entries.service_area_detail: Franchise independent pharmacies. Retail pharmacy: copays are normally paid at pickup, so there is usually no monthly bill. Any unpaid pharmacy balance or delivery order is paid in the store, the app, or the pharmacy account. Detailed support pages not researched.

entries.name: Walgreens Pharmacy
entries.parent_company: Walgreens (Walgreens Boots Alliance; taken private by Sycamore Partners 2025)
entries.service_area_detail: ~8,000 retail pharmacies in all 50 states, DC, PR; plus Walgreens mail service and AllianceRx Walgreens specialty.
entries.phone_customer_service: 1-877-250-5823 (Walgreens.com customer service); pharmacy account phone verification 1-800-573-3586
entries.notes: The Pharmacy Help FAQ covers most tasks. Pay an outstanding balance: Account Home > Prescriptions > Settings > Make a Payment (card or check); View recent transactions on the Pharmacy Account Balance page to confirm a payment posted. ExpressPay (stored card that is auto-charged when prescriptions are filled) is set up under Settings > ExpressPay and removed with the Delete link on the same screen. Prescription history can be viewed and printed for the last 18 months. Pharmacy help FAQ: to remove ExpressPay, go to Your Account > Settings > ExpressPay and click Delete, then Yes. Prescription records: Prescriptions > Records > choose dates > Print, available for 18 months. Older records need a request form. Walgreens pharmacy help: ExpressPay stores a card for prescription pickups (set up at /rx-settings/rxsettings/pay; remove it with the delete link in Rx settings); cards are managed under Account > Profile > Payment Methods. Auto Refill is managed at walgreens.com/rx-refillhub/autorefill. For FSA/tax records, Account Home > Prescriptions > Records prints all prescription transactions for the year (online records cover about 18 months; older records by mailing the PHI access request form).

entries.name: Walmart Pharmacy
entries.service_area_detail: ~4,600 Walmart pharmacies plus Walmart Pharmacy mail order and Walmart Specialty Pharmacy. Retail copays are paid at pickup; mail order and delivery are charged to the payment method on the Walmart account.
entries.phone_customer_service: Walmart customer care 1-888-537-5503; Walmart Mail Order Pharmacy 1-800-2-REFILL (1-800-273-3455); Walmart Specialty Pharmacy 1-877-453-4566; or call the store pharmacy
entries.payment_processor: in-house (Walmart account payment methods; HSA/FSA, credit/debit, gift cards, PayPal)
entries.senior_programs: Walmart $4 generic prescription list; Walmart+ members get free Rx delivery where available; Specialty Pharmacy screens copays for patient assistance programs.
entries.notes: Refill order payment type is changed with Edit in the Payment field (per search snippet). Mail order page: https://www.walmart.com/cp/pharmacy-mail-order/1042239. Download Pharmacy History article: sign in > Pharmacy > Pharmacy history shows up to 24 months for you and managed family members, downloadable as PDF or CSV. This is useful for tax and medical-expense records. The Prescription Status and Pharmacy Refill Orders article  says the refill order's payment type is changed with Edit in the Payment field; there is no separate pharmacy bill. The Walmart Help Center lists pharmacy articles under Health and Wellness (Estimated Prescription Refill Costs, Manage Family Prescriptions, Add or Update Insurance). Prescription history page: https://www.walmart.com/health-and-wellness/pharmacy/rx/history (sign-in required).
